title: be동사 과거 (was / were)
goal: was / were로 '~이었어요', '~에 있었어요'라고 지난 일을 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: was / were = be동사의 과거
points.body: am / is / are의 과거 모양이 was / were예요. '~이었어요', '~했어요(상태)', '~에 있었어요'라는 뜻이에요.

points.title: I, He, She, It → was
points.body: I, he, she, it, 그리고 한 사람·한 개(Tom, the coffee)는 was를 써요. am과 is가 과거에는 둘 다 was가 돼요.

points.title: You, We, They → were
points.body: you, we, they, 그리고 여러 사람·여러 개(my housemates)는 were를 써요. are의 과거가 were예요.

points.title: 과거 시간 표현과 같이
points.body: yesterday(어제), last night(어젯밤), last week(지난주), two days ago(이틀 전), this morning(오늘 아침) 같은 말이 나오면 was / were를 써요.

mistakes.why: I는 am의 과거인 was를 써요. were는 you / we / they용이에요.
We는 여러 명이라 were. 주어가 여러 명이면 were라고 기억하세요.
한국어는 '어제'만 있어도 과거가 느껴지지만, 영어는 동사도 과거(was)로 바꿔야 해요.

examples.en: I was tired after work yesterday.
We were at Bondi Beach last weekend.
examples.ko: 우리는 지난 주말에 본다이 비치에 있었어요.

examples.en: It was cold and windy this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침은 춥고 바람이 많이 불었어요.

examples.en: She was a nurse in Korea.
The tram was full last night.
You were great at the interview!

quiz.why: I + 과거 = was. last night이 있으니 am은 안 돼요.
the weather는 하나니까 was. last weekend는 과거예요.

quiz.sentence: My parents ___ in Sydney two weeks ago.
quiz.why: my parents는 여러 명이라 were. two weeks ago는 과거.
I + was + busy. 어제니까 과거형 was.

quiz.answer: We were at the cafe last night.
choices: We were at the cafe last night.
We was at the cafe last night.
We are at the cafe last night.
We were the cafe last night.
quiz.why: We + were + at + 장소. '~에'는 at을 써요.
영화 한 편이니까 was. 순서는 주어 + was + fun.

quiz.answer: They were students a year ago.
choices: They were students a year ago.
They was students a year ago.
They are students a year ago.
They were student a year ago.

quiz.why: my boss는 한 명이니까 was. yesterday가 있으니 is는 안 돼요.

quiz.answer: The shops were closed last Sunday.
choices: The shops were closed last Sunday.
The shops was closed last Sunday.
The shops is closed last Sunday.
The shops closed were last Sunday.

quiz.answer: It was rainy two days ago.
choices: It was rainy two days ago.
It were rainy two days ago.
It is rainy two days ago.
It rainy was two days ago.
quiz.why: It은 was. two days ago는 과거예요.
